correctness.rationale: Translation then ambient scaling automorphisms normalize b=0,u=1; scaling need not be inner in H, but it preserves rank by pullback. Frobenius irreducible decomposition has m nonsingular 1-dimensional blocks and (p-1)/m irreducibles of dimension m. Each nontrivial block is diag(1+zeta^{kh}) plus an m-cycle; cyclic recurrence makes kernel at most one-dimensional, determinant zero exactly when product_h(1+zeta^{kh})=(-1)^m. Reduction modulo cyclotomic prime (1-zeta) forces (-2)^m=1 and hence -2 in the unique subgroup H; conversely if -2 in H, 2H=-H and quotient (1-zeta^{2kh})/(1-zeta^{kh}) telescopes with sum_H h=0, giving determinant zero for all induced blocks. Regular-representation multiplicities give p-1 nullity, none intermediate. Independently computed exact cyclotomic coefficient reduction for p=5,7,11,13,17,19 and all multipliers a!=1, agreeing with iff -2 in H. Finite tests only corroborate full proof.
